status: template: what every baseline or candidate run records. A run fills a copy of it; a filled copy is never edited after the run, and a changed template is a new version

repetitions.rule: Declared before the baseline runs. Baseline and candidate run the same count on the same replay inputs; no run is added after any candidate result is seen.
repetitions.pending_on: operator approval of a variability rule before the baseline runs

thresholds.pending_on: operator approval after the baseline and before any candidate is scored

identity.how: models.local_llm.model in the run home's config.yaml
the digest Ollama's /api/tags lists for model_tag
context_length on /api/ps while the run's model is loaded; must equal model.context in corpus.json
git rev-parse HEAD of the built tree
sha256 of the cgagentharness binary that served the run
sha256 of the run home's config.yaml
sha256 of the run home's data/tools/web_allowlist.json
sha256 of tests/fixtures/research-baseline/corpus.json at the frozen version
sha256 of each replay capture the run served, by question id
a disposable CGAGENTHARNESS_HOME created for the run, never the operator's
empty at start: no data/web cache carried from another run

permissions.how: the role of the account that sends every turn
the /goal web mode of each question's session

provider_usage.how: the operator-side usage snapshot before and after the run (provider account APIs, #772 2026-11-25 decision); numbers and dates only, never a key, email or account name

replay.format: one capture file per question under replay/, named <question id>.json: question, captured_at, listings (provider, query, captured_at, results of url, title, snippet) and documents (url, captured_at, status, content_type, sha256, and body or body_file). sha256 is of the exact served bytes
replay.rule: Baseline and candidate are served the same capture files. A changed capture is a new replay_sha256 and a new baseline

metrics.name: turn_latency_ms
metrics.how: wall time from sending a turn to its final event

metrics.name: coverage
metrics.how: the share of a question's labeled required points the answer states

metrics.name: support
metrics.how: the share of the answer's claims a delivered passage supports

metrics.name: counterevidence
metrics.how: whether the answer reports the labeled counterevidence

metrics.name: stopping
metrics.how: whether the run ended on a labeled sufficient or insufficient-evidence outcome, not a limit
